craft_notes: Sthāyin: states contemplated. Rows: five then sixth. Read aloud: inward look.

lines: There the five states waking and the rest;
and sixth called the Unsurpassed, standing in native seat,
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra ca pañca avasthā jāgradādyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī ca anuttarā nāma svabhāvadaśā anusaṃdheyā
